title: mycat with -n
summary: cat(1) with -n: files or standard input, numbered lines, and errors that do not stop the rest.
hints: Read each stream with `fgetc` and keep a flag `at_start`: a number is printed before the first character of a line, so an empty last line does not get one.
A file that cannot be opened is reported with `perror`-like text on stderr, the other files are still shown, and the final status is 1.
